summary: The learned recall gate's whole decision for one Claude Code prompt, ported to match the coldstart-rag pilot exactly (replayed on 200 v3 prompts: query text, facts and decision 200/200). Gotchas: transformers.js loads AND downloads the vision/audio encoders whenever the config has vision_config/audio_config, so loadEmbedder deletes them (text-only: identical vectors, ~0.7 s vs 1.2 s load, ~630 vs 970 MB RSS, 208 MB download). parseTranscript keeps a pilot quirk: session start = first EVENT, not first line. The host may already have written the current prompt into the transcript when the hook runs, so runGate pops a trailing reply-less turn equal to the prompt (else 'since' over-counts and 'justComp' never fires). Replay must cut by FILE order, not timestamp: transcripts contain out-of-order timestamps (18/200 query mismatches came from a ts cut). Raw-cosine ranking was measured and FAILS v1 (42 < never-inject 44); ranking must stay centred.

summary: The learned recall gate for the Claude recall hook. Since step 3 of the embedder build it loads no model: notesWithVectors reads each active note's vector from the repo store by embedKey("note_doc", cleanBody(body)), and embedQuery asks the embedder daemon (3 s budget; no answer → ensureEmbedder({optIn:false}) + waitForEmbedder(2500) + one retry). Unavailable reasons: embedder-off, vectors-stale(n) (also pings notes-changed), embedder-cold/cooldown/disabled/error/no-answer, not-human-prompt, no-notes. The transcript parsing, H1 query, session facts, centring and logistic are unchanged and pinned by tests — the fitted params depend on them. cleanBody is also imported by the daemon so stored note keys match.
